en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a panoramic view of a town with many trees and houses. The foreground features a large house with a peaked roof and garden, while the background shows more residential buildings, some with classic European architecture. The setting appears green and suburban, and the image has a vintage feel. The lower left corner contains the text 'Arnsdorf bei Dresden.'
